17081.subject: Christian Religious Knowledge (CRK)
17081.question_text: the concept of faith and work as enunciated by James means
17081.explanation: The concept of faith and work as enunciated by James primarily means observing one's face in the mirror in readiness for good works. In James 1:22-25, James discusses the relationship between faith and action. It emphasises the importance of not only hearing or knowing the word of God but also putting it into action through good works. James encourages believers to be doers of the word, not just hearers, by using the analogy of looking at oneself in a mirror and then immediately forgetting what one looks like. This metaphor portrays the idea that faith should lead to tangible actions and righteousness, rather than mere passive observance or memorisation of religious teachings.

options.text: practising religion without bridling the tongue
observing one's face in the mirror in readiness for good works
hearing and memorizing the word of God
hearing the word and remaining unstained in the world
